identity.title: Retain Grayscale Learn View Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: GrayscaleLearnView.xaml.cs의 concrete owner 감사가 완료되었다. View Partial은 required XAML/presentation adapter로 유지되고, GrayscaleLearnPresenter, Learn Window topic/action composition, and View-owned WPF cell/marker/brush/timer owners가 lesson state, routing, presentation, lifetime, and test boundaries를 각각 소유한다. 독립 seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, focused source/build/WPF/monitor and documentation evidence가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit GrayscaleLearnView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing concrete owners already provide lesson state, topic routing, timer lifetime, binding, and test boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve GrayscaleLearnView XAML names, automation IDs, Apply/Close/ThresholdTool event contracts, topic routing, animation behavior, test facade, and Unloaded timer cleanup.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that GrayscaleLearnView has no direct persistence/file-dialog/OpenCV/tool-factory coupling and that the existing presenter, Learn Window composition, timer lifetime, callback, explicit result events, and XAML/test owners are wired.

Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus Grayscale Learn WPF smoke and dynamic monitor geometry pass; broader theme/DPI/input/native related-tool/camera/SDK/GPU runtime remains explicitly unverified.

evidence.observation: GrayscaleLearnView remains a required XAML/presentation adapter. GrayscaleLearnPresenter owns threshold/brightness/arithmetic/filter lesson state, simulation/evaluation decisions, staged guidance and fixed Tool text; OpenVisionLearnWindow owns topic/action composition and the public/test facade; and the View owns only WPF cell/marker/brush projection, callback forwarding, explicit Apply/Close/ThresholdToolRequested result events, and timer attach/detach. The View has no direct file, dialog, OpenCV, tool-factory, persistence, or inspection coupling, so no independent production seam was found.
GrayscaleLearnPartialBoundaryContract passed all 11/11 source checks in Debug and Release. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

RunUiPrecheck passed wpf_openvision_learn_grayscale_contract and wpf_openvision_learn_grayscale_view in Debug and Release with OK 2/2, layout/text/internal counts zero, and fresh 1040x700 and 760x700 PNGs. Broader theme/DPI/input, native related-tool click/file association, camera/SDK/GPU and long-running runtime matrices remain unverified.

Dynamic monitor probing selected the smaller-left monitor \\.\DISPLAY2 with bounds X=-1920,Y=365,1920x1080; the Grayscale Learn smoke window was explicitly moved there and the resulting window intersected the selected monitor. MoveSucceeded is true and IntersectingWindowCount is 1.

events.summary: GrayscaleLearnView Partial은 required XAML/presentation adapter이며, GrayscaleLearnPresenter, Learn Window topic/action composition, and View-owned WPF cell/marker/brush/timer owners가 독립 책임과 lifetime을 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 forwarding wrapper나 WPF control leakage가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.

PL-0050의 세 completion criteria가 현재 source, contract, build, WPF smoke, monitor, and documentation evidence로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, native related-tool click/file association, camera/SDK/GPU 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Grayscale Learn View Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF/monitor/documentation evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
